newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's TV Azteca says Q1 market share 34 percent.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's TV Azteca says Q1 market share 34 percent.

text.p: Mexican television company TV Azteca garnered an average weekday prime-time audience share of 34 percent during the first quarter, the company said on Thursday.
In a conference call with analyts, TV Azteca's Chief Financial Officer Adrian Steckel said the company would release its full first quarter earnings in the next few weeks.
Azteca said in a statement on Thursday that its weekday prime-time audience share during 1996 grew from 18 percent in January to 37 percent in December.
Azteca added that its average audience share during weekday prime time for 1996 as a whole was 28 percent compared to 15 percent in 1995.
The average of weekday prime-time programming produced by Azteca increased from 39 percent in January to 75 percent in December, the company said.
The company also said it racked up net income in 1996 of $100 million compared to a net loss of $93 million. Its 1996 net revenues $238 million compared to $123 million the year before.
